text.tspan: Chain attitude candidates across consecutive epochs via Euler equations & omega-consistency filtering.
Exponential culling via forward/backward passes narrows candidates to 0-5 survivors.
BLOCK 1: Select Chain of Consecutive Epochs
separated epochs with large mag differences (>0.5 mag).
Output: Chain epoch indices [i1, i2, ... i10]
BLOCK 2: Isobrightness Sampling at Each Epoch
Per epoch: N_SEEDS = 5,000-10,000 random SO(3) seeds.
Cull if angle > omega_bound x dt
Loop over chain links j = 0 to N_CHAIN - 2
KEY: After K links, survival rate
A candidate at epoch j survives only if
it has >=1 valid partner at epoch j+1
that itself survived the forward pass.
Each survivor has a valid path through all epochs.
Uses KD-tree for efficient spatial matching
For each candidate with derived omega:
BLOCK 7: Propagate & Score Full Light Curve
Generate lo-fi or hi-fi light curve
Test Case: Intelsat 901 (~10k facets) | True: q0 from axis=[0.6,0.3,0.8]/norm, angle=45 deg | omega0=[0.5,-0.3,2.0] deg/s | 3600s window, 500 epochs
Key Strength: Exponential culling - each chain link eliminates ~90-99%. 10 links -> survival ~ 1e-10 to 1e-20 of initial space.
